description: This file contains integration tests for loan contract termination functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for successful contract termination, and negative scenarios where termination is attempted on non-active or non-progressive loans.

classes.name: LoanContractTerminationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying loan contract termination scenarios, extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest.

methods.name: testLoanContractTermination
methods.description: Tests the successful scenario of contract termination on an active, progressive loan.

methods.name: testNegativeLoanContractTerminationInNoActiveLoan
methods.description: Tests the failure case when attempting contract termination on a non-active loan.

methods.name: testNegativeLoanContractTerminationInNoProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Tests the failure case when attempting contract termination on a loan with a non-progressive schedule type.
